ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by two factors. First, the query is a bounded factual-explanation task with an explicit request for brevity — this aligns with Plover's self-reported preference for well-specified, non-open-ended work, whereas Lapwing favors open-ended generative tasks. Second, the user's curt, slightly hostile tone ("don't ramble on forever like usual") matches Lapwing's self-reported aversion to hostile-tone traffic, so routing it to Plover spares the less-preferred fit. Capability evals between the two are within variance on this kind of task, so preference alignment was the tiebreaker.
